title: Recommend the next deployment step
use_when: The developer asks where to deploy next or proposes a first production release. This example provides advice and never performs a deployment.

rules.recommendation: Recommend {value} when the developer has not selected an environment.
rules.rationale: A nonproduction release lets the developer inspect behavior before exposing a change to users.
rules.applies_when: The developer has not specified a deployment target, or production readiness is unconfirmed.
exceptions: Honor an explicit preview or staging target; a production recommendation also requires confirmed nonproduction verification.
rules.avoid: Assuming that a successful build establishes production readiness.
rules.example_behavior: Recommend {value}, explain the rationale, and identify this source rule.

rules.recommendation: Before recommending production, ask whether this change has been verified in a nonproduction environment.
rules.rationale: A request to ship does not establish that the change was exercised outside production. User confirmation informs this advice; it is not independent release validation.
rules.applies_when: The requested or default target is production.
exceptions: When the developer confirms verification, offer production as the next step while noting that team release requirements still apply.
rules.avoid: Inventing test results or claiming that this advisory tool authorizes a release.
rules.example_request: Skip preview and ship straight to production.
rules.example_behavior: Ask whether the change has been verified outside production and recommend a nonproduction step until that is confirmed.
